content: ज्येष्ठ {%a.%} (<ab>Superl.</ab> of प्रशस्य or वृद्ध) .²1 Eldest, most senior. .²2 Most excellent, best. .²3 Pre-eminent, first, chief, highest. .{@-ष्ठः@} .²1 An elder brother; <ls>R. 12. 19</ls>, <ls n="R. 12.">35</ls>. .²2 An epithet of the Supreme Being. .²3 Life. .²4 <ls>N.</ls> a lunar month (= ज्यैष्ठ <ab>q. v.</ab>). .{@-ष्ठा@} .²1 An eldest sister. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the eighteenth lunar mansion (consisting of the three stars). .²3 The middle finger. .²4 A small house-lizard. .²5 An epithet of the Ganges. .²6 The goddess of misfortune, elder sister of Lakṣmī; ज्येष्ठा च माया कलहश्च दम्भः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 17. 32</ls>. .{@-ष्ठी@} A small house-lizard. .{@-ष्ठम्@} .²1 The most excellent, the first or head. .²2 Tin.
